meta.provider: NOAA National Weather Service (NWS), National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP); mosaic of River Forecast Center analyses
meta.dataset: Stage IV daily multisensor (radar and rain gauge) quantitative precipitation estimate, 24-hour totals ending 1200 UTC
meta.nativeGrid: HRAP polar stereographic, 1121 x 881 cells, about 3.8 km at 30 N
meta.units: inches in the source; converted here with 1 inch = 25.4 mm
meta.regrid: Value of the nearest HRAP cell at the centre of each 0.05 degree cell (no smoothing, no interpolation). Values are rounded to whole millimetres; -1 = no data in the source.

nativeGridMaximumInDomain.note: Largest 10-day total of any native HRAP cell whose centre is inside the domain.
